author: Xinlong12580
body: This pull request adds the first nerual network graph in the ONNX format for the incoming neural network based cluster parameter estimator (NNCPE) module in CMSSW. It is trained on 2025 CMSSW simulation data and is required for further testing of the NNCPE module in CMSSW.
title: Add Run 3 2025 PixelCPENN ONNX model
